businessRules: P3 FULL is runtime-verified on exact-source commit c61273e99104c0dbdc61ee4790379d4ed2edd8a3 / fingerprint cfe0323c096eb253730c1751e37ecc3a0b4e77853d3048360271ed97e360f8c5; P3 source is frozen absent regression evidence.
P4 is one atomic delivery wave for A-10 and canonical ownership cleanup; legacy return aliases may be removed only after active-consumer verification and canonical /returns/* runtime proof.

Canonical domain ownership for inventory, returns, accounting, payments, notifications, payroll, assets, marketplace and summaries is defined by config/canonical-domain-ownership.json and must pass audit:canonical:ownership.
P4 exact-runtime closure requires ci:p4:probe PASS in both heavy GitHub workflows and aggregate evidence on the same source fingerprint with productionTouched=false.

P4 FULL is runtime-verified on exact-source commit d305ade2050765de86c7f5ef1c54eb7426c5e25b / fingerprint cf6165fcc74e94abb3866230aa1764cee9487d4de6b630377465d20bda7d9246; P4 source is frozen absent regression evidence.
P5 is one atomic visual-product wave across Admin, POS, Storefront and Employee Portal; global CSS-only or marker-only closure is forbidden.

P5 automated closure requires audit:p5:visual plus exact-source ci:p5:probe screenshot evidence for 14 Admin primary workspaces, 13 Admin contextual routes, 4 POS views, 5 Storefront views and 7 Employee Portal views at 1440/1024/390 geometry.
P5 automated PASS does not replace human visual acceptance; A-07 remains IMPLEMENTED_RUNTIME_PENDING until exact-source automated evidence is green and human UI acceptance is recorded separately.
acceptanceCriteria: P4 removes the legacy /sale-returns* and /purchase-returns* mutation surfaces only after proving no active repository consumer remains and canonical /returns/* runtime routes stay live.
P4 documents one canonical owner and source-of-truth/ledger contract for inventory, returns, accounting, payments, notifications, payroll, assets, marketplace, and summaries.
P5 visual rebuild provides product-specific page composition for Admin, POS, Storefront and Employee Portal instead of a global-CSS-only treatment.
P5 exact-source Browser UAT captures the complete configured screenshot matrix and proves desktop/tablet/mobile geometry without uncontrolled overflow.
P5 human visual acceptance remains explicit and cannot be auto-promoted by automated screenshots or source tests.
testPlan: Exact-source PostgreSQL P4 runtime: npm run ci:p4:probe; evidence handoff/quality/github-p4-canonical-ownership-probe-latest.json must PASS with productionTouched=false.
Both full-system-simulation and toko360-full-uat must report P4 canonical ownership probe success before P4 can become RUNTIME_VERIFIED.
Exact-source Browser/runtime P5: npm run ci:p5:probe; evidence handoff/quality/github-p5-visual-rebuild-probe-latest.json must PASS with productionTouched=false and humanAcceptance=PENDING.
Both full-system-simulation and toko360-full-uat must report P5 visual rebuild probe success before automated P5 evidence is considered green; human visual acceptance remains separate.
verificationGates: P4 exact-source runtime gate proves canonical /returns/* stays live, legacy /sale-returns* and /purchase-returns* are router-missing/absent from Swagger, and nine-domain ownership manifest is complete.
P4 aggregate gate requires handoff/quality/github-p4-canonical-ownership-probe-latest.json PASS on current source and productionTouched=false.
P5 exact-source visual gate requires page-level screenshot coverage for all configured Admin/POS/Storefront/Employee surfaces plus 1440/1024/390 responsive matrices.
P5 aggregate gate requires github-p5-visual-rebuild-probe-latest.json PASS on the current source fingerprint with productionTouched=false while preserving humanAcceptance=PENDING until human review.
